text:
Alice (Partner Ops): Heads-up — QBR next Wed. Need final MDF capacity split between SI onboarding (APAC pilot) and Marketplace launch credits. SI is asking for 40% of Q3 MDF; Marketplace PM is pushing for 50%. We have ~$120k total. Triage now in 30m?
Ben (Marketplace PM): Can we stagger credits? :thinking: marketplace needs runway for launch promo + HW partner co-funding. If SI gets 40% now we risk launch momentum.
Chloe (SI Lead): SI is asking for 40% because APAC pilot needs onboarding engineers + certs. We can accept phased disbursal over 8 weeks if that helps.
Darren (Finance): Finance check — $120,000 total. 40% = $48k, 50% = $60k. We can't exceed $120k. What are must-haves vs nice-to-have?
Eva (RevOps): Recommend a scorecard tweak: add 'time-to-live' for credits and milestone gates. Suggest 25% holdback until first 30-day metrics hit.
Frank (Head of Partnerships): Can we model three scenarios quickly? Marketplace-first, SI-first, Balanced. Quick numbers please.
Alice (Partner Ops): Quick scenarios below — pick one in triage.
```
Scenario A: Marketplace-first
- Marketplace: $70,000
- SI Onboarding: $30,000
- Holdback: $20,000

Scenario B: Balanced
- Marketplace: $50,000
- SI Onboarding: $50,000
- Holdback: $20,000

Scenario C: SI-first
- SI Onboarding: $70,000
- Marketplace: $30,000
- Holdback: $20,000
```
Ben (Marketplace PM): Marketplace can accept B if we get an extension on PR runway. Can we repurpose holdback early if metrics are met?
Eva (RevOps): Yes — propose milestone gates: 30% after kickoff, 40% after first 10 customer signups, final 30% after M1 metrics. Need tracking via Redwood Console metrics.
Chloe (SI Lead): SI prefers C but will accept B with a formal SLA and certification schedule within 2 weeks.
Darren (Finance): We'll need signed SOWs before disbursement. Can legal fast-track?
Frank (Head of Partnerships): Action items: Alice run 30-min triage now; deliver final split + scorecard updates by EOD. @mdf-bot please create a task in Partner Ops board. :white_check_mark:
mdf-bot: Task created: "QBR MDF split decision" — owners: Alice, Ben, Chloe — due today EOD. Link: https://org.tasks/12345
Alice (Partner Ops): On it. Joining the call in 5. Agenda: choose scenario, define holdback gates, assign owners. If you can't join ping me. :rocket:
